# The XML parser of MOD-result-records

**REGISTER**

The self-contained ESM browser build of `@rgrove/parse-xml` 5.0.0 is copied unchanged from its npm archive. Only its
filename is `parse-xml.mjs`, so Node and the browser both load it as ESM without a package manifest or build step.
The library performs XML parsing; `junit.mjs` owns only the JUnit-to-Outcome mapping. Its ISC licence is kept beside it
and is compatible with Agent M's MIT licence. No external document type definition is fetched by this parser.
